questions.prompt: Which keyword starts a switch statement?
questions.explanation: The switch keyword tests a variable against multiple case values.

questions.prompt: What keyword defines a branch inside a switch?
questions.explanation: Each possible value is written as case value:

questions.prompt: What keyword ends each case block to prevent fall-through?
questions.explanation: break exits the switch. Without it, execution falls through to the next case.
A switch statement uses switch(expression) { case value: ... break; }.

questions.prompt: What happens if no case matches and there is no default?
questions.explanation: If no case matches and default is absent, the switch block completes without executing any case.
The default case runs when no other case matches.

questions.prompt: Write the exact keyword required after each case value
Write a switch that prints 'Fri' when day == 5
questions.starterCode:
int day = 5;
// Write your switch below

questions.prompt: Can multiple cases share the same code block?
questions.explanation: You can stack case labels before a single block to share code between cases.

questions.prompt: What type is typically used in a switch expression?
questions.explanation: Switch works with integral types, string, char, and enums. Switch expressions support many more types.
